svg.text: "Nietzsche only describes two moralities and takes no side"
three sentences the claim cannot accommodate, each with the standard it ranks by
noble valuation "acts and grows spontaneously"; the slave's "action is fundamentally a reaction"
ranks by: origin — active before reactive, a Yes before a No
value-tables "need primarily a physiological elucidation"; "the good of the
majority and the good of the minority are opposed standpoints"
ranks by: value for a stronger type, not for the greatest number
"the slave's gaze resents"; "pessimistic suspicion"; "'good' and 'stupid' come closer together"
ranks by: its own vocabulary — suspicion, utility and contempt are not neutral descriptions
what the ranking standard is, and whether it survives the critique, is the will-to-power lesson's question
